method: independent first-pass graph-guided static source review
graph_scope_note: Graph supplies definition/import edges and function ranges, not a resolved call graph. Entry-to-call-chain paths were traced manually from source.

status_semantics.clean: No confirmed defect in this inspected body within stated static scope; not runtime proof, not paired review, not a claim about uninspected callees.
status_semantics.finding: Inspected body contains a confirmed first-pass source defect; separate independent review handled by reviewer.
status_semantics.blocked: Body not inspected because exact range is explicitly held.

context_only_reads_not_added_to_coverage.purpose: caller entry and route context; no identity helper or runtime config read
static regression inventory only; existing timeout test covers one failed worker, not two

portability_notes: No active personal absolute host path or fixed vendor/model string found in reviewed module code. honrui appears only in a historical performance comment.
Luna bridge suffix and default OpenClaw agent main/port18789 are adapter conventions; gateway module, export, config and agent have explicit environment overrides.
Hermes CLI reports generic model label hermes/configured; it does not resolve actual model identity in this adapter. This is documented metadata behavior, not proof of which model ran.

Subprocess environment propagation cannot be certified because its helper is explicitly held. Installed Hermes/OpenClaw contract compatibility, real process behavior and runtime availability were not exercised.
